input.summary: The shell is in parts/shell.mjs and make.sh builds a whole build.nbt. It has the brick base with six vents, white main-block and rear-wing walls, quartz courses at y3, y10 and y17, floors and ceilings, partitions, doorways and openings left as air, corner pilasters, and the living-room cove. My part had no refused writes. The run's roof lines list off-palette blocks (tuff bricks and others), which I did not touch.
left: Not run or checked by eye: no render, no `mcd fit`, and the room-by-room walk finds every room unreachable. The walk expects the gallery, steps and front door, which later parts add.
The upper floor is open over x45..50 z50..59 as the plan says. The stairs part has to close the rest of it.
The chimney cells (x33-34 and x61-62, z46-47 and z56-57) are air at y3, y10 and y17 so the stacks can go in from y0. The plinth there is solid bricks.
The ventArch helper was not used. I wrote the vents by hand because its SITE_Y y offset doesn't match this grid.
The roof tool reports off-palette blocks (tuff bricks, cobbled and polished deepslate stairs and slabs): roof.json needs fixing.
The bay widths for the interior doors were not in the plan, so I chose them. The rear-room windows at z61 x33..34 and x61..62 open onto the 2-thick partitions behind them.
The pilaster column x26 z42 runs through the wall; the orphan quartz blocks the check lists are not from this part.

waste.what: Hand-listed partitions, interior doorways and window openings as carve/fill calls, with the doorway offsets worked out from rooms.json.
waste.cost: about 60 fill/carve calls, one retry-prone pass
waste.tool: A wall-and-partition generator that reads rooms.json (rooms and doorway pairs) and emits walls, doorways and window openings.

waste.what: Worked out which cells the four chimney stacks cross, so the floors and ceilings leave them clear.
waste.tool: Make floor/ceiling helpers accept a list of keep-clear boxes.

waste.what: ventArch has a SITE_Y offset that doesn't match this grid, so I placed the vents by hand.
waste.tool: Make the vocab helpers take the grid's y origin from SITE_SIZE or a parameter.

companions.task: Quoins, a brick water table and the string-course profile, which I left plain.
Close the upper floor around the stair well and add the landing.
Fill all the window openings, with sills, lintels and shutters.
